items.text: Bħal fi tfulitna, meta Maman kienet tħoll il-ħajt tas-suf mill-ħwejjeġ il-qodma, u aħna konna nieħdu l-ħajta u nduru mad-dar biex il-ħajt tas-suf ma jinġemax fuq xulxin.
items.q: Is it clear the children walk around inside the house, holding the yarn?

items.text: Kemm-il darba għidtlu, tolqotx it-tfal, qal, laqtitni l-mewġa tal-isplużjoni fil-gwerra, ma nistax nikkontrolla ruħi. Rajt li hekk kienet, u ħallejtu.
items.q: Maman means she gave up arguing with him. Is that clear?

items.text: Hamid ġibed 'il fuq iċ-ċintorin l-aħmar imċajpar tal-libsa tal-glieda tiegħu u, b'daqqa ta' dahar idu, tefa' l-għoqda tal-ħsara wara dahru minn fuq spallejh.
items.q: Hamid pulls up the shoulder strap of his singlet. Is 'ċintorin' the right word?

items.text: Ċaqalqet rasha. Fuq il-mejda ta' Norouz, meta qrajt il-poeżija għal ommi, Maman, minflok ma ferħet, saret ansjuża.
items.q: She shakes her head to say no. Does 'Ċaqalqet rasha' show that?
Is it clear he means: don't shake your head like that?

items.text: Ħarab b'veloċità ogħla mid-dawl, jekk le kont neqirdu.
items.q: The speaker means he'd have hung him up by the backside. Is that clear?

items.text: Minn ġol-ħabta tal-bieb tal-kabina tad-doċċa, ħarist 'il barra.
items.q: Amir peeks out through a gap in the shower door. Is 'ħabta' right?

items.text: It-tifla ta' Baba timbotta l-ġugarell żgħir roża tagħha u titbiegħed tagħmel viżż viżż.
items.q: Is it clear the girl is pushing a small pink kick scooter?
